newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Chubais to meet IMF on Monday - Interfax.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Chubais to meet IMF on Monday - Interfax.

text.p: Russian First Deputy Prime Ministers Anatoly Chubais and Vladimir Potanin will meet the mission from the IMF in Moscow on Monday, Interfax news agency said, quoting a source close to the IMF delegation.

Alexander Livshits, who Itar-Tass news agency said would be replaced by Chubais as Finance Minister in a government under formation, said earlier a 1997 economic plan could be ready for agreement with the IMF within two weeks.
Tass said that Chubais would fulfil his present post and that of Finance Minister. Potanin's position in a new cabinet, if any, has not been announced.
Russia must agree an annual plan with the International Monetary Fund in order to receive disbursements of the three-year $10 billion IMF loan to Russia. --Moscow Newsroom, +7095 941 8520
